race.comment: HANEY (7) scored a dominant Maiden win two back at Moree, then covered ground early with a fighting fourth over 1000m at Tamworth in BM66 class. Finds an easier race with the claim and is sure to be thereabouts. NEVERMISTA (1) has gone to a new level this prep and finds an easier assignment with Dalton's 2kg claim. Strong through the line with a narrow third over 1000m at this track. Genuine top four contender. CASSIERE (2) talented mare resuming. Closed strongly with the 58.5kg when second over 1000m at Eagle Farm on August 13, last year. SIMPLY BETTER (8) struggled to run the 1200m out when eighth over 1200m at this track last time out. Assess on the good win over this trip two back. Each-way.
